failure.line: She knows there's no success like failure
stanza: She knows there's no success like failure
And that failure's no success at all

failure.line: But as for me I'm coming to my final failure
stanza: But as for me I'm coming to my final failure
Killed myself with changes trying to make things better
Ended up becoming something other than what I had planned to be
Now I believe that lovers should be draped in flowers
And laid entwined together on a bed of clover
Left there to dream of their happiness
